options.horsingaround.title: Horsing Around
options.horsingaround.subtitle: How riding looks and sounds to you.
options.horsingaround.third_person.toolt: Switch to the riding camera behind you when you climb on, and back to first person when you get off.
options.horsingaround.camera_distance.to: How far behind you the riding camera sits. It still pulls back a little as your horse picks up speed.
options.horsingaround.camera_height.tool: How far above your eyes the riding camera sits. Lower brings it down toward your horse's back.
options.horsingaround.camera_claimed.too: Over the Shoulder is placing your riding camera, so its own riding distance and height apply. Change them in its settings.
options.horsingaround.speed_zoom.tooltip: How much the view widens at a canter and a gallop. Turn it down if fast motion bothers you.
options.horsingaround.view_bob.tooltip: How much your view rises and falls with your horse's stride in first person. Off with Minecraft's View Bobbing off, too.
options.horsingaround.hand_bob.tooltip: How much your hands and what you're holding move with the stride in first person.
options.horsingaround.horse_sounds.toolt: The sounds this mod adds: breathing and blowing when tired, snorts, hooves digging in on hard turns, rustling leaves. Vanilla horse sounds follow the Friendly Creatures volume.
message.horsingaround.server_missing: This server doesn't have Horsing Around, so horses ride as in vanilla
message.horsingaround.server_mismatch: This server runs Horsing Around %s, which doesn't match yours (%s), so horses ride as in vanilla
options.horsingaround.hat.support: Get a cowboy hat: buy me a coffee
options.horsingaround.hat.support.toolti: Supporters get a cowboy hat to wear, in any colour. This opens my Buy Me a Coffee page: put your Minecraft username in the message and your hat shows up within a day or two. Thank you!
options.horsingaround.hat.tooltip: Wear your supporter hat. Your helmet still protects you, it just isn't drawn while the hat is on. Everyone with the mod on the same server sees it.
options.horsingaround.hat_hue.tooltip: The colour of the hat, round the colour wheel.
options.horsingaround.hat_richness.toolt: How strong the colour is. All the way down for greys, black and white.
options.horsingaround.hat_brightness.too: How light or dark the hat is.
